
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Johness/p/23325648" title="发布于 2026-10-16 11:43">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">瑞芯微rv1106进入Loader模式转储emmc数据</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>　　最近遇到个问题，设备在用户手里变砖了。我们把设备拿回来，接上调试串口，打印如下输出</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/372875/202610/372875-20261016105344886-2005047846.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　看起来是有分区数据损坏，肯定是需要把emmc数据读取出来看看。</p>
<p>　　有条件的话可以把emmc吹下来，然后用烧录器读取。但我们嵌入式软件岗位研发没这个手艺。就只能从软件上想办法。</p>
<p>　　先进maskroom（在uboot下输入download）。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/372875/202610/372875-20261016105750917-1207072378.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　（一直打印RKUART就成功了）</p>
<p>　　然后进工具套件进入Loader模式</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/372875/202610/372875-20261016105908031-1692439902.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/372875/202610/372875-20261016110100362-2047812524.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　然后查询分区表，选择分区进行读取即可。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/372875/202610/372875-20261016113528580-1823467368.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　注意，如果读取过程中报错，则需降速使用</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/372875/202610/372875-20261016114100231-1724757001.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　不过出现这个错误而降速后，需要重进Loader模式才能读取了。</p>
<p>&nbsp;　　</p>
<p>　　更新于：2026-10-16&nbsp;11:41:57</p>

</div>
